preview.what: API design: resources, versioning, pagination, filtering, webhooks.
preview.picture: A well-labelled shop: predictable aisles, prices on everything, and a delivery service (webhooks) that tells the customer when things change.
preview.why: Cursor vs offset pagination and versioning strategy are standard senior questions.
preview.bn: গোছানো দোকান: চেনা তাক, সবকিছুর দাম, আর delivery (webhook) যা বদল হলে জানায়।
